blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Being able to spend over P300,000 in a day to buy shoes and having a dinner in Tokyo, Japan, worth P200,000, are not the hallmarks of living a simple life, members of the prosecution team told Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday. In a press briefing after Duterte’s impeachment trial, two prosecutors and two spokespersons for the panel said that the report and testimony of financial forensic analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera has shattered the image of the Dutertes being relatable to a middle-income family. The prosecution was referring to the “unusual banking behavior” flagged by Cabrera in his […]...
